environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on a single EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2. Application listens on port 3000 with no reverse proxy. Security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3000. No network ACLs restricting localhost traffic. Instance metadata service v1 enabled (no IMDSv2 requirement). No outbound traffic filtering.
